# `kaolin/ops/conversions/SDFToMesh.js`

> **Source:** `engine/kaolin/ops/conversions/SDFToMesh.js`

SDFToMesh.js — Extract triangle mesh from a Signed Distance Field Converts a 3D SDF volume (Float32Array grid) into a triangle mesh using Marching Cubes. This is the CPU path for Kaolin conversions; for GPU-accelerated MC see engine/voxel/MarchingCubesMesher.js. Also supports evaluating analytical SDF functions directly. Compatible with: - MeshToVoxel.js voxelGridToSDF() output - MeshSDFGenerator.js baked SDF textures - SDFCollision.js primitives - FlexiCubes (future Phase 3+)

## Functions

### `sdfToMesh(sdf, resX, resY, resZ, options = {})`

Extract an isosurface from a 3D SDF grid using Marching Cubes.

**Parameters:**

- `sdf` *(Float32Array)* — — signed distance values, indexed [x + y*resX + z*resX*resY]
- `resX` *(number)* — — grid resolution X
- `resY` *(number)* — — grid resolution Y
- `resZ` *(number)* — — grid resolution Z
- `options` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `options.origin` *(Float32Array)* — — world position of grid corner (default [0,0,0])
- `options.voxelSize` *(number)* — — size of each voxel (default 1)
- `options.isoValue` *(number)* — — isosurface threshold (default 0)

**Returns:** }

### `sdfFunctionToMesh(sdfFn, boundsMin, boundsMax, resolution = 64, options = {})`

Mesh an analytical SDF function by evaluating it on a grid.

**Parameters:**

- `sdfFn` *(Function)* — — (x, y, z) => signed distance
- `boundsMin` *(Float32Array)* — — [x, y, z] minimum corner
- `boundsMax` *(Float32Array)* — — [x, y, z] maximum corner
- `resolution` *(number)* — — voxels per longest axis (default 64)
- `options` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `options.isoValue` *(number)* — — threshold (default 0)

**Returns:** }

### `sdfCSGToMesh(ops, boundsMin, boundsMax, resolution = 64)`

Mesh a CSG combination of SDF primitives. Accepts an array of { sdf: fn(x,y,z), op: 'union'|'subtract'|'intersect' }.

**Parameters:**

- `ops` *(Array)* — — [{ sdf: Function, op: string }]
- `boundsMin` *(Float32Array)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `boundsMax` *(Float32Array)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `resolution` *(number)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

**Returns:** }
